text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali reshuffles his cabinet. Changes in the key portfolios, of finance, interior, defence, the presidency, foreign affairs and justice. New ministers enter the cabinet.
- President Ben Ali on Monday received trade union leader Ismail Sahbani who reiterated the union's support for the government's plans to modernise the economy.
- Renault names a Tunis-based manager in charge of North Africa.
- Statistics on divorce in Tunisia: 12,197 cases in 1990 from 6,956 cases in 1985.
- Food prices fell at the Tunis wholesale market.
- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui to visit Spain from January 26-28.
- Biographies of the ministers named on Tuesday by President Ben Ali.
